claim: Completed parallel selection, with overlapping own proof/compilation work. No isolated speed, causal cache attribution or final acceptance.
scope: Same-backend native versus Arc snapshot envelopes and identical staging/revision/journal work. Native roots remain a benchmark prototype.
observations: Native ownership does not establish across-the-board superiority.
Scalar compact-adaptive-owned-once-70 native read ratio to its Arc control is about 0.703, but its native all-miss median remains about 3.159 times hashbrown.
Scalar native shard-owned-group-50-1024 acquisition is about 2086 times its Arc control; copying an embedded directory on every snapshot is a real tradeoff to retain.
Generic tables retain all shapes/cases and every regression; do not select a different root policy per case.
